name: OpenRouter

free_tier.notes: Applies to models with IDs ending in :free when lifetime credit purchases are under $10
One-time purchase of at least 10 credits (~$10) raises the daily :free-model cap permanently
Per-minute cap for all :free model variants regardless of credit balance

notes: Perpetual free tier, not a trial: :free model variants are usable indefinitely without payment, but only at 50 req/day until you buy $10+ of credits (then 1,000 req/day). Free-model availability fluctuates — models are rotated in/out by providers, and capacity is governed globally so extra accounts do not raise limits. Accounts with a negative balance can get 402 errors even on free models. No credit card needed to sign up or use :free models.
